body:
## Problem

Declared-surface drift. `package.json:13-15` declares `"node": ">=20"`, but the runtime dependency this package installs, `markdownlint-cli` 0.49, cannot run on Node 20, and its dependency `ini` 7 excludes everything below 22.22.2 and 24.0-24.14.

## Evidence

Fresh install of the committed lockfile; `semver.satisfies` against every package in the `dependencies` closure (75 packages):

```text
node 20.20.2 blocked by: markdownlint-cli 0.49.1 (>=22); commander 15.0.0 (>=22.12.0); markdownlint 0.41.1 (>=22); ini 7.0.0 (^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0)
node 24.10.0 blocked by: ini 7.0.0 (^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0)
versions satisfying the closure: 22.22.2, 24.15.0, 26.0.0
```

## Impact

Consumers on Node 20, 22.0-22.22.1 or 24.0-24.14 are told they are supported and get a `markdownlint` binary that does not support their runtime.

## Fix

Set `"engines": { "node": "^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26" }` (or pin `markdownlint-cli` to a release whose closure supports the floor you want to keep) and note it in the next release.

## Resolution
Owner chose (s)pec: engines.node set to "^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26"; README states the floor; test.yml matrix floor moved to 22.22.2 / 24.15.0 / 26 (node --test passes on all three).
title: engines promises Node >=20 but markdownlint-cli and ini need ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26

body:
## Problem

The package ships `"postinstall": "node scripts/postinstall.cjs"`. pnpm 12 fails the install with `ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` for any dependency with an unapproved build script; Yarn 4 defaults to `enableScripts: false` and skips it. `README.md:27` promises "After installing it, a _`.markdownlint.json`_ file will be created automatically".

## Evidence

Consumer installs in scratch projects (pnpm 12.4.1, Yarn 4.18.0, npm 11.19.0):

```text
$ pnpm add -D @ivuorinen/base-configs     # includes this package
ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS: … @ivuorinen/markdownlint-config 1.3.12 …  → exit 1
$ CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile  # config package present → exit 1
$ pnpm add -D prettier                    # control, no build script → exit 0
Yarn 4: YN0004 … all build scripts have been disabled → exit 0, no .markdownlint.json written
```

npm 11.19 still runs it but warns `install-scripts not yet covered by allowScripts`.

## Impact

pnpm 12 consumers cannot install; Yarn 4 consumers silently lint with markdownlint's defaults (e.g. MD013 at 80 columns, MD033 on) while believing the shared config is active.

## Fix

Replace the `postinstall` with an explicit initializer `bin` and document creating `.markdownlint.json` with `{ "extends": "@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config" }` by hand. If the postinstall stays, document the pnpm (`pnpm approve-builds`) and Yarn 4 behaviour.

## Resolution
Owner chose the document-only fix: README now tells users to create .markdownlint.json, and states npm runs the postinstall (with an allowScripts warning), Yarn 4 does not, and pnpm fails until `pnpm approve-builds` (verified on pnpm 12.4.1). Postinstall unchanged by owner decision.
title: postinstall breaks pnpm 12 installs and never runs under Yarn 4, contrary to the README

body:
## Problem

Ad-hoc unpinned package. `publish.yml:61-63` and `pr-lint.yml:38-40` run `npm install -g corepack --force && corepack enable` — the latest corepack with lifecycle scripts enabled — and in `publish.yml` that runs in the job holding `NPM_TOKEN` and `id-token: write`. `.github/zizmor.yml` suppresses `adhoc-packages` for both files.

## Evidence

```yaml
# .github/workflows/publish.yml:61-63
      - name: Install and enable corepack
        shell: sh
        run: npm install -g corepack --force && corepack enable
```

`base-configs-stylelint` pins this step and adds `--ignore-scripts`.

## Impact

A malicious or broken corepack release runs with the publish credential in scope and decides which Yarn builds the release.

## Fix

`npm install -g --ignore-scripts corepack@0.35.0 && corepack enable` in both files (this repo's `.nvmrc` is 26, which no longer bundles corepack).

## Resolution
publish.yml installs `corepack@0.35.0` with --ignore-scripts (Node 26 has no bundled corepack); pr-lint.yml installs the same pinned copy only on Node 25+. zizmor.yml justification updated; zizmor --pedantic: no findings.
title: Release and lint jobs npm-install a floating corepack with install scripts enabled

body:
## Problem

`publish.yml:65-75` restores `node_modules` keyed on `hashFiles('**/yarn.lock')` and runs `yarn install` only on a cache miss, without `--immutable`. A `package.json`-only change or `.nvmrc` bump keeps the key and releases from a stale tree.

## Evidence

```yaml
          key: node-modules-${{ hashFiles('**/yarn.lock') }}
      - name: Install Dependencies
        if: steps.cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: yarn install
```

`base-configs-stylelint/.github/workflows/publish.yml:86-93` records this pattern shipping a wrong release (1.4.0).

## Impact

semantic-release can apply stale release rules from `node_modules` and publish the wrong version.

## Fix

Run `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build` unconditionally and add `.nvmrc` to the cache key.

## Resolution
publish.yml install runs unconditionally as `yarn install --immutable --mode=skip-build`; cache key includes .nvmrc.
title: Release install is skipped on a cache hit keyed only on yarn.lock and is not --immutable

body:
## Problem

Excess permissions. `publish.yml:23-28` grants the `Linter` job `issues: write` and `pull-requests: write`, but `publish.yml` triggers only on `push` to `main`, so there is no issue or PR for the linter to comment on — while the job still runs a third-party action with `NPM_TOKEN` in its environment.

## Evidence

```yaml
# .github/workflows/publish.yml:23-28
    permissions:
      statuses: write
      contents: read
      packages: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
```

`base-configs-commitlint` resolved the same defect ("This workflow triggers on push only, so there is no pull request or issue for the linter to comment on — no write scope for either").

## Impact

A compromised lint step gets write access to issues and PRs for no functional gain.

## Fix

Drop `issues: write` and `pull-requests: write` from the `Linter` job.

## Resolution
Dropped issues: write and pull-requests: write from the push-only Linter job in publish.yml.
title: The push-only Linter job in publish.yml holds issues and pull-requests write it cannot use

## Problem

`pre-commit run --all-files` on a clean `main` exits 1: `pretty-format-json` (`.pre-commit-config.yaml:19-20`) rewrites `.releaserc.json`, which Prettier (MegaLinter's JSON formatter) formats differently.

## Evidence

```text
$ pre-commit run --all-files
pretty format json.......Failed
- hook id: pretty-format-json
- files were modified by this hook      (.releaserc.json)
```

`base-configs-commitlint/.pre-commit-config.yaml` removed the hook for this reason.

## Impact

Installed hooks produce a reformat loop and cannot serve as a CI gate.

## Fix

Delete the `pretty-format-json` hook and let Prettier own JSON formatting.

## Resolution
Removed the pretty-format-json hook; `pre-commit run --all-files` exits 0 with no files modified.
title: pre-commit --all-files fails on main: pretty-format-json fights Prettier

Non-gating check. `pr-lint.yml`, `codeql.yml` and the new `test.yml` run on `pull_request`, but `main` is unprotected and has no rulesets, while `allow_auto_merge` is `true`.

body:
## Problem

The non-releasing rule in `.github/renovate.json` matches only `"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "pre-commit"]`, and the major-prefix rule only `["pre-commit"]`. Renovate's `nvm` manager, which updates `.nvmrc`, matches neither. `.nvmrc` is not in `package.json` `files`, and the workflows read it only through `node-version-file`, so a Node bump there never reaches consumers. Renovate still titles it with the preset default scope `deps`.

## Evidence

- Shared preset `github>ivuorinen/renovate-config` sets `semanticCommitScope: "actions"` only for `matchManagers: ["github-actions"]`, and sets `commitMessagePrefix: "chore(deps)!: "` on every `major` update. Its `chore(actions): ` override for majors covers github-actions only.
- Shared release rules (`@ivuorinen/semantic-release-config` 3.0.0 `index.cjs:11-13`): `chore(deps)` gives a patch, breaking `chore(deps)` gives a major, and `chore(actions)` gives no release.
- Observed: ivuorinen/base-configs#577 and ivuorinen/base-configs-commitlint#196 (branch `renovate/node-26.x`, which changes only `.nvmrc`). Renovate titled both `chore(deps): update node.js (…)`, including force-pushes made after the actions/devDependencies rule landed (#578 / #201). The maintainer renamed both to `chore(actions): …` by hand before merging (PR timeline `renamed` events by the maintainer).

## Impact

Unless someone retitles the PR, every Node minor or patch bump merges as `chore(deps)` and publishes a needless patch release. In config-checker, each release then fans out into Renovate bumps across every @ivuorinen package. A Node major (for example 26 → 28) arrives as `chore(deps)!:` and publishes a **major** release of the package, even though consumers see no change.

## Fix

Add `"nvm"` to both manager lists, and update the first rule's description so it names `.nvmrc` as well:

```json
"matchManagers": ["github-actions", "nvm", "pre-commit"],
…
"matchManagers": ["nvm", "pre-commit"],
"matchUpdateTypes": ["major"],
"commitMessagePrefix": "chore(actions): "
```

The better fix is to make the same change once in the shared `ivuorinen/renovate-config` preset, next to its github-actions major rule, so all nine repos pick it up.

## Resolution
Fixed in the shared preset, ivuorinen/renovate-config#114 (merged as 503bbff): nvm (.nvmrc) and pre-commit updates get the literal prefix "chore(tooling): " and devDependencies/require-dev get "chore(dev-deps): " for every update type, so none carries the global "chore(deps)!: " major marker; "actions" stays reserved for github-actions. @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config releases on the deps scope only, so tooling and dev-deps commits cut no release (checked through commit-analyzer). ivuorinen/base-configs-markdownlint#204 then removed every local scope, prefix and group rule from this repo's .github/renovate.json, which now only extends the shared preset.
title: Renovate .nvmrc (nvm manager) updates are titled chore(deps) and release the package

body:
## Problem

Excess secret exposure. `publish.yml:15-16` and `pr-lint.yml:15-17` put `NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}` in the workflow-level `env:`, so every job and step receives it — the `Linter` job's MegaLinter action in `publish.yml`, and in `pr-lint.yml` the checkout, corepack install and `Simek/yarn-lock-changes` (also handed it explicitly at line 48). Only the Semantic Release step needs an npm credential, and with `id-token: write` already granted it could use OIDC trusted publishing instead (`setup-node` runs with `always-auth: true`; `.github/zizmor.yml` suppresses `use-trusted-publishing` as "tracked separately").

## Evidence

semgrep and opengrep (`gha-workflow-env-secret`, WARNING) report `publish.yml:16` and `pr-lint.yml:16`; manual sweep confirms both plus `pr-lint.yml:47-48`. `base-configs-stylelint/.github/workflows/publish.yml:15-17` documents the fix.

## Impact

Any compromised lint action or MegaLinter-bundled tool can read a token able to publish `@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config`, on every push and every same-repo PR.

## Fix

Delete both workflow-level `env:` blocks and the lint steps' `NPM_TOKEN` lines; set `NPM_TOKEN` only on the Semantic Release step — or complete trusted publishing (configure the npm trusted publisher, drop `always-auth` and `NPM_TOKEN`) and delete the secret.

## Resolution
Removed the workflow-level env blocks from publish.yml and pr-lint.yml and the NPM_TOKEN lines on the lint steps; NPM_TOKEN now appears only on the Semantic Release step. OIDC trusted publishing and secret deletion remain the owner's action. Later, on 2026-09-26, #203 (a69ee1b) completed both: publish.yml now publishes through OIDC trusted publishing (id-token: write) with no NPM_TOKEN, and the NPM_TOKEN repository secret no longer exists (checked 2026-10-01).
title: NPM_TOKEN is exposed workflow-wide in publish.yml and pr-lint.yml, including to third-party actions

body:
## Problem

`.github/renovate.json` lacks the `packageRules` entry that gives GitHub Actions and pre-commit updates the `actions` scope; a major action bump becomes `chore(deps)!: …`, which the shared release rules map to `major`.

## Evidence

This repo's `v1.0.0` came from commits including `96497aa chore(deps)!: update actions/checkout (v5.0.1 → v6.0.0) (#72)`, `3f0404e chore(deps)!: update github/codeql-action (v3.30.7 → v4.30.7) (#47)` and `54fc5c5 chore(deps)!: update renovatebot/pre-commit-hooks (41.160.1 → 42.0.3) (#63)`.

## Impact

The next major action or hook bump publishes a new major of `@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config` with no consumer-visible change.

## Fix

Add `"packageRules": [{ "matchManagers": ["github-actions", "pre-commit"], "semanticCommitType": "chore", "semanticCommitScope": "actions" }]`.

## Resolution
Added the packageRules entry giving github-actions and pre-commit updates semanticCommitType chore, scope actions. Later superseded: ivuorinen/renovate-config#114 moved this into the shared preset ('actions' for GitHub Actions only, 'tooling' for pre-commit and .nvmrc), and #204 removed the local rule; see audit-314d998c.
title: Renovate CI-only major bumps are labelled chore(deps)! and would cut a major release

body:
## Problem

Coverage gap on a non-critical path. The suite (`test/postinstall.test.mjs`) exercises only the install script. Nothing loads `@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config` through its own name, so the `exports` map (`.` → `index.json`) and the `files` allowlist are never verified.

## Evidence

Mutation check: pointing an `exports` condition at a missing file, or dropping an entry file from `files`, leaves `yarn test` at `pass 4, fail 0`. The sibling `base-configs-stylelint` shipped exactly this defect class (`exports["./css"]` pointed at the SCSS files through 1.3.5, fixed in 71799ce), and `base-configs-commitlint/test/resolve.test.mjs` resolves its package by name for that reason.

## Impact

A broken entry point reaches npm with a green suite; every consumer install then fails to load the config.

## Fix

Add `test/resolve.test.mjs` that resolves `@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config` by name via `createRequire(import.meta.url)` (CJS) and `await import()` (ESM) and asserts each returns the expected value, plus `npm pack --dry-run --json` asserting every file referenced by `exports` is in the tarball.

## Resolution
Added test/resolve.test.mjs resolving @ivuorinen/markdownlint-config by name via require and import (JSON import attributes). Passes (2/2); pointing exports['.'] at a missing file makes both fail (restored after). The npm pack half of the fix was missing until 2026-10-01: test/pack.test.mjs now runs npm pack --dry-run and asserts that main, every exports target and the postinstall script are in the tarball. Dropping scripts/* from files makes it fail on scripts/postinstall.cjs, and an exports target outside files that is not main fails it too. npm always packs main, so index.json itself could not be dropped through files.
title: No test resolves the published entry points, so an exports-map break would ship green

body:
## Problem

dependency-vulnerability in the published runtime tree (markdownlint-cli) and the release chain.

## Evidence

osv-scanner 2.7.0, trivy 0.76.0 `--include-dev-deps` and `yarn npm audit --recursive` agree: markdown-it 14.3.2 (GHSA-gfr2-rv44-r23c high, GHSA-vfgh-jcmw-g37q; fixed 14.3.3), js-yaml 5.2.3 (GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm; 5.4.1), smol-toml 1.7.2 (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2; 1.9.0), katex 0.16.35 (GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7; 0.18.2), ip-address 10.7.2 (GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5; 10.7.4). markdownlint-cli 0.49.1 requests `markdown-it ~14.3.0`, `js-yaml ~5.2.1`, `smol-toml ~1.7.0`; micromark-extension-math requests `katex ^0.16.0`.

## Impact

markdownlint-cli is this package's runtime dependency, so consumers resolve the same ranges; js-yaml, smol-toml and katex fixes are unreachable inside those ranges.

## Fix

Update markdownlint-cli to the newest release whose ranges admit the fixed versions, raise the `dependencies` floor to it (consumer-visible, so it releases), `yarn up -R` the rest, confirm osv-scanner exits 0. Do not force katex or js-yaml across their parents' ranges with `resolutions`.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 8d1ba82 + 410cce7 + cbc14d9: lockfile re-resolved under the 3-day gate, markdownlint-cli floor raised to ^0.50.0 (js-yaml 5.5.0, smol-toml 1.9.1, markdown-it 15.0.3), katex GHSA-238p-pmpm-9mq7 ignored in osv-scanner.toml with reachability evidence (renderToString never called) until 2027-01-27; osv-scanner -r .: No issues found.
title: yarn.lock resolves 5 packages with advisories, three of them pinned by markdownlint-cli's ranges

## Problem

The resolve tests compare `index.json` against a literal copy of itself (`MD013` deep-equals `{ line_length: 200, ... }`). Nothing feeds a Markdown file through markdownlint-cli with `extends: "@ivuorinen/markdownlint-config"`.

## Evidence

`test/resolve.test.mjs` asserts `config.default === true` and the `MD013` object; `test/pack.test.mjs` checks the tarball contents; `test/postinstall.test.mjs` checks the starter file. None invokes `markdownlint`. commitlint's `resolve.test.mjs` and stylelint's `smoke.mjs` run their real CLIs for the same reason.

## Impact

A markdownlint-cli upgrade that renames a parameter (markdownlint ignores unknown keys) leaves the config partly inert with every test passing.

## Fix

Add a test that writes `.markdownlint.json` extending the package and a file with a 201-character line into a temp dir, runs `node_modules/.bin/markdownlint` on it, and asserts a non-zero exit mentioning MD013, plus a 200-character line that passes.

## Resolution
fix/audit-2026-10 615d9cc: test/markdownlint.test.mjs runs markdownlint-cli with the config; making MD013, code_blocks, MD024, MD033 or default inert each fails one test.
title: No test runs markdownlint-cli with the config, so an option it stops honouring ships green

body:
## Problem

With no .github/dependabot.yml, Dependabot titled the security updates it opens after the repository's own history, `chore(deps)`, which @ivuorinen/semantic-release-config releases as a patch. Those updates change only yarn.lock, which `files` in package.json does not publish, so each release shipped nothing new.

## Evidence

Of the 9 releases tagged since 2026-09-01, three contained only a Dependabot security bump and changed only yarn.lock: v1.3.11 (#199), v1.3.12 (#200) and v2.0.3 (#209). No dependabot.yml has ever existed here, so every Dependabot PR was a security update; all were titled `chore(deps): bump ...`, including the open #218. Under the installed semantic-release-config 3.0.8, commit-analyzer returns `patch` for `chore(deps): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10`.

## Impact

Each such merge publishes a version with no consumer-visible change, and the release history stops saying which versions changed anything.

## Fix

Add a security-only .github/dependabot.yml: `open-pull-requests-limit: 0` (version updates stay with Renovate; the limit applies only to version updates), `versioning-strategy: lockfile-only` and `commit-message.prefix: chore(lockfile)` (both also apply to security updates), plus a 7-day cooldown for zizmor's dependabot-cooldown audit. `chore(lockfile)` matches no release rule.

## Resolution
004d7ad adds a security-only .github/dependabot.yml: open-pull-requests-limit 0, lockfile-only versioning, prefix chore(lockfile), 7-day cooldown. Under the installed semantic-release-config 3.0.8, commit-analyzer returns null for a chore(lockfile) bump and patch for the chore(deps) control.
